'''Darth Charnus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] and the right hand of [[Darth Decimus]], the [[Dark Council]] member overseeing the [[Sphere of Military Strategy]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|My master has spent many years learning of the Revanites. Together, we have exposed many.|Emic Sandor, Charnus' apprentice, describes his master to Imperial heroes|<ref name="Initiation" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="3643BBY">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Darth Charnus and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Emic Sandor]], sought the destruction of the [[Order of Revan]].<ref name="Initiation" />

At the start of the [[Galactic War]], Charnus joined the [[Battle of Corellia]] to aid in the crushing of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] resistance. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] utilised a personal dreadnought that was combined of the [[Centurion-class battlecruiser/Legends|''Centurion''-class battlecruiser]] ''[[Tears of Taris]]''; which was present at the bombardment of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and so named for it, before finding its way into the Sith Empire and served it for the next 300 [[Standard year/Legends|years]]; and parts from the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower'']] line of [[Starship/Legends|ships]].

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|My Master prefers to remain in the shadows, but do not doubt his power&mdash;nor his ability to reward success.|Emic Sandor, Charnus' apprentice, describes his master to Imperial heroes|<ref name="Initiation" />}}
Charnus exhibited a cordial and refined manner. He lacked cunning but compensated for it with cruelty. His viciousness was remarkable, even among the Sith, particularly when interrogating helpless prisoners.
<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Darth Charnus}}</ref>

==Powers and abilities==
Charnus had a talent for extracting information and he was often assigned to investigate secret organizations and societies within the Sith seeking the Empire's downfall. His methods were effective and his successes at rooting out and executing traitors were largely responsible for his senior position among the Sith. Numerous innocent individuals suffered at his hands but he always managed to keep collateral damage from his investigations to acceptable levels.<ref name="Codex" />

==Equipment==
Darth Charnus possessed a Sith amulet<ref name="The Master's Secret">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Master's Secret|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref> and a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="NPC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I "obtained" this Sith amulet from Charnus. Give it to Sandor. He'll believe you stole it from his master while among the Revanites. They will turn against each other.|Revanite leader Tari Darkspanner tries to convince Imperial heroes to frame Darth Charnus as a Revanite|<ref name="The Master's Secret" />}}
Darth Charnus appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He was first mentioned in the Imperial mission "Initiation", part of the Dromund Kaas planetary story arc.<ref name="Initiation" /> He later appeared and figured prominently in the beginning part of the Imperial planetary story arc for Corellia.<ref name="Corporate Warfare" />

At the conclusion of the Dromund Kaas planetary story arc, player characters have the dark side option of revealing Tari Darkspanner as the leader of the Order of Revan to Sandor or the light side option of presenting Darth Charnus' stolen amulet to Sandor to falsely implicate him as a Revanite.<ref name="The Master's Secret" />
